# Porn Recovery Research & Knowledge Library

The evidence layer of the recovery platform: research summaries with source-type and
evidence-strength ratings, a claims database with explicit statuses, and structured
controversies. Educational information; not medical advice.

## Core sections

- Research: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/research/ — 20 study summaries (DOI/PMID where verified)
- Topics: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/topics/ — 30 concept pages
- Claims: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/claims/ — 11 common claims rated against evidence
- Controversies: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/controversies/ — 4 structured scientific debates
- Evidence standards: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/evidence/ — source type × evidence strength
- References: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/references/

## Policies

- Disclaimer: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/disclaimer/
- Editorial Policy: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/editorial-policy/
- Privacy: https://data.selfcontrolatlas.com/privacy-policy/

## Main site

- https://selfcontrolatlas.com/ — experiences, patterns, triggers, strategies, editorial analysis
